business_problem: scale network telemetry and customer analytics fast enough to support global venues, near-real-time reporting, and new AI-led wireless operations.
solution_summary: Boingo Wireless uses Snowflake, Snowpipe, and Snowpark on Snowflake to scale network telemetry and customer analytics fast enough to support global venues, near-real-time reporting, and new AI-led wireless operations. Network utilization, speed, interference, and circuit data are centralized in Snowflake so venue, network, and customer teams can work from a faster, more reliable operating view. Snowpipe keeps ingestion near real time so the platform can act on operational signals quickly. Keeping ingestion, storage, transformation, and governed access on one platform reduces handoffs, simplifies operations, and makes it easier to reuse trusted data across analytics, reporting, and AI. Boingo improved near-real-time network visibility across global venues, strengthened customer reporting with Insights 2.0, and supports connectivity experiences that reach more than 1 billion people each year.

solution_components.name: Snowflake
solution_components.role: Provides the centralized data platform that stores governed datasets and serves analytics or AI workloads.

solution_components.name: Snowpipe
solution_components.role: Continuously ingests streaming or event data into Snowflake with low operational overhead.

solution_components.name: Snowpark
solution_components.role: Runs transformations, analytics, and application logic directly where Snowflake data already lives.

data_flow: network utilization, speed, interference, and circuit data flow into Snowflake, Snowpipe, and Snowpark; curated data, reports, and model outputs are then served to venue, network, and customer teams.
